title: Mr.Dec: Daily-Scale Longitudinal Multimodal Modeling for 30-Day Readmission Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.16929v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting 30-day hospital readmission is essential for assessing patient stability and optimizing healthcare resources. As clinical risk evolves with the accumulation of evidence during hospitalization, capturing these dynamic trajectories is essential. However, many existing approaches compress the complex longitudinal history into fixed representations, often losing the granular, day-level clinical signals that reflect a patient's evolving physiological state. To address this, we propose Mr.Dec (Multimodal Readmission-risk prediction Decoder), which models each admission as a natural chronological sequence of daily multimodal events. By leveraging a Transformer Decoder, Mr.Dec integrates daily Electronic Health Record(EHR) updates and intermittent Chest X-ray(CXR) findings in a time-aligned stream, reflecting the actual clinical workflow. To ensure robustness, we utilize Disease-Specific Supervised Contrastive Learning as an auxiliary

translated_title: Mr.Dec：面向30天再入院预测的日尺度纵向多模态建模
translated_abstract: 预测30天再入院对于评估患者稳定性和优化医疗资源至关重要。由于临床风险会随着住院期间证据的积累而演变，捕捉这些动态轨迹至关重要。然而，许多现有方法将复杂的纵向病史压缩为固定表示，往往会丢失反映患者生理状态演变的细粒度、日级临床信号。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Mr.Dec（多模态再入院风险预测解码器），它将每次入院建模为自然时间顺序的每日多模态事件序列。通过利用Transformer解码器，Mr.Dec在时间对齐的流中整合每日电子健康记录（EHR）更新和间歇性胸部X光（CXR）结果，以反映实际临床工作流程。为确保稳健性，我们采用疾病特异性监督对比学习作为辅助手段。
tldr: 本文提出Mr.Dec模型，通过将住院过程建模为日尺度多模态事件序列，利用Transformer解码器动态整合每日EHR和CXR数据，以更精准地预测30天再入院风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Mr.Dec, which models hospitalization as daily-scale multimodal event sequences and uses a Transformer decoder to dynamically integrate daily EHR and CXR data for more accurate 30-day readmission prediction.
